question: According to the Global Multidimensional Poverty Index 2022, around _______ people in India climbed out of poverty between 2005-06 and 2019- 21.
solution:
The correct answer is **415 million.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Global Multidimensional Poverty Index 2022,** around **415 million** people in India climbed out of poverty between 2005-06 and 2019- 21.
 
• The recently released 2022 Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) by the **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)** and the **Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI)** presents significant insights into global poverty dynamics.
 
• **Global Data**:Approximately 1.2 billion individuals are identified as multidimensionally poor, with almost half of them experiencing severe poverty.
 
 
• Among the impoverished, 593 million are children below the age of 18.Sub-Saharan Africa hosts the highest number of poor individuals (579 million), followed by South Asia (385 million), collectively representing 83% of the global impoverished population.
 
 
 
• **Impact of the Pandemic**:The MPI data does not capture post-pandemic changes, but the report warns that the COVID-19 pandemic may reverse global poverty reduction progress by 3-10 years.
 
 
• According to the World Food Programme, the number of people in food crises or worse increased to 193 million in 2021.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Key Findings about India:

 
 
• India has the largest global population living in poverty, totaling 228 million, followed by Nigeria with 96 million.
 
• Two-thirds of the impoverished in India reside in households where at least one person faces nutritional deprivation.From 2005/06 to 2019/21, India witnessed a substantial reduction in poverty, with the incidence falling from 55.1% to 16.4%. 
 
• The improvements across all 10 MPI indicators contributed to more than halving the MPI value and poverty incidence.
 
• During the 15-year period from 2005-06 to 2019-21, 415 million people in India moved out of poverty, significantly influencing the decline in poverty in South Asia.South Asia now has a lower number of poor people compared to Sub-Saharan Africa.
 
 
 
• **Relative Reduction in Poverty : **
 
 
• The relative reduction in poverty accelerated from 2015/16 to 2019/21, with a rate of 11.9% per year, compared to 8.1% from 2005/06 to 2015/16.
 
• Bihar, the poorest state in 2015-16, exhibited the fastest reduction in MPI value in absolute terms.
 
 
 
• **Performances of States :**
 
 
• Bihar demonstrated substantial progress, with the percentage of poor decreasing from 77.4% in 2005-06 to 34.7% in 2019-21.
 
• While Bihar improved, most of the 10 poorest states in 2015/2016, except West Bengal, remained in the list in 2019-21.
 
 
 
• **Poverty among Children :**
 
 
• Absolute reduction in poverty among children was faster, despite India still having the highest number of poor children globally.
 
• More than one in five children in India live in poverty, compared to approximately one in seven adults.
 
 
 
• **Reduction of Poverty region wise :** 
 
 
• The incidence of poverty declined from 36.6% in 2015-2016 to 21.2% in 2019-2021 in rural areas and from 9.0% to 5.5% in urban areas.
